info.name: Gymini API Tests
info.description: API tests for the Gymini backend endpoints

item.name: Health Check

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response has status OK', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('OK'); });
pm.test('Response has service name', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.service).to.eql('Gymini API'); });
pm.test('Response time is acceptable', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });

item.name: Generate Plan - Valid Request

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response has mode field', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('mode'); });
pm.test('Mode is mock-ai', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.mode).to.eql('mock-ai'); });
pm.test('Response has headline', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('headline'); });
pm.test('Response has weeklyPlan array', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.weeklyPlan).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Plan has correct number of days', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.weeklyPlan).to.have.length(4); });

pm.test('Each day has exercises', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); data.weeklyPlan.forEach(day => { pm.expect(day.exercises).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(day.exercises.length).to.be.above(0); }); });
pm.test('Response has progression advice', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('progression'); });
pm.test('Response has safety note', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('safety'); });
pm.test('Response time is acceptable', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(2000); });

item.name: Generate Plan - Strength Goal

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Plan is for strength goal', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.headline).to.include('strength'); });

pm.test('Exercises use strength rep scheme', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); const firstExercise = data.weeklyPlan[0].exercises[0]; pm.expect(firstExercise.prescription).to.include('4-6'); });

pm.test('Rest is 2-3 minutes for strength', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); const firstExercise = data.weeklyPlan[0].exercises[0]; pm.expect(firstExercise.rest).to.include('2-3 minutes'); });

item.name: Generate Plan - Fat Loss Goal

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Plan is for fat-loss', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.headline).to.include('fat loss'); });

pm.test('Exercises use higher rep scheme', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); const firstExercise = data.weeklyPlan[0].exercises[0]; pm.expect(firstExercise.prescription).to.include('10-15'); });
pm.test('Finisher is cardio for fat loss', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.weeklyPlan[0].finisher).to.include('incline walk'); });

item.name: Generate Plan - Bodyweight Equipment

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Exercises are bodyweight focused', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); data.weeklyPlan.forEach(day => { day.exercises.forEach(ex => { pm.expect(['Push-ups', 'Goblet squats', 'Dumbbell rows', 'Romanian deadlifts', 'Plank', 'Walking lunges']).to.include(ex.name); }); }); });

item.name: Generate Plan - Missing Required Fields

exec: pm.test('Status code is 400', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Response has error message', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('message'); pm.expect(data.message).to.include('Missing'); });

pm.test('Response lists missing fields', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('missing'); pm.expect(data.missing).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.missing.length).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: Generate Plan - Empty Body

exec: pm.test('Status code is 400', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test('Response has missing fields list', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.missing).to.include.members(['age', 'height', 'weight', 'goal', 'experience', 'daysPerWeek', 'equipment']); });

item.name: Generate Plan - Different Day Counts

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Plan has 2 days', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.weeklyPlan).to.have.length(2); });
pm.test('Split is full body for 2 days', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.weeklyPlan[0].focus).to.include('Full Body'); });
